/* 관리자메뉴 - 시스템심사진행현황 (8050) */ /* AdminStatusMapper.selectList */
SELECT X.* FROM ( SELECT M.INPT_MST_SRNO AS INPT_MST_SRNO --심사마스터일련번호 ,M.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT --심사접수일자 ,M.ACTL_FX_REFNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO --ACTUAL외환참조번호 ,M.FX_REFNO_SRNO AS FX_REFNO_SRNO --외환참조번호일련번호 ,M.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD --심사자동화업무구분코드 ,M.AI_INPT_APPV_STCD AS AI_INPT_APPV_STCD --결재진행상태코드 ,(SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '150' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = M.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD) AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSNM --심사자동화업무구분명 -- ,M.AI_INSPE_ENO AS AI_INSPE_ENO --AI심사자직원번호 ,(SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ENO = M.AI_INSPE_ENO) AS AI_INSPE_ENO ,M.AI_INPT_PROS_CD AS AI_INPT_PROS_CD --AI심사프로세스코드 ,(SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '280' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = M.AI_INPT_PROS_CD) AS AI_INPT_PROS_NM --프로세스명 ,M.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD AS AI_INPT_ACVT_CD --AI심사활동코드 ,(SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '290' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = M.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) AS AI_INPT_ACVT_NM --AI심사활동명 ,NVL(Q.AI_INPT_PRC_DSCD,'3') AS AI_INPT_PRC_DSCD --AI심사처리구분코드 ,(SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '361' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = NVL(Q.AI_INPT_PRC_DSCD,'3')) AS AI_INPT_PRC_DSNM --AI심사처리구분명 ,NVL(Q.AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD, H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD) AS AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD --AI심사진행상태코드 ,(SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = DECODE(Q.AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD, null, '300','360') AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = NVL(Q.AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD, H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD)) AS AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STNM --AI심사진행상태명 -- ,(SELECT AI_INPT_INTF_ITM_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = DECODE(Q.AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD, null, '300','360') AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = NVL(Q.AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD, H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD)) AS PROCESS_GROUP --,NVL( -- (SELECT AI_INPT_INTF_ITM_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '360' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = NVL(Q.AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD, H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD)), -- (SELECT AI_INPT_INTF_ITM_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '300' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD)) AS PROCESS_GROUP
,(SELECT AI_INPT_INTF_ITM_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = DECODE(Q.AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD, null, '300', '360') AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = NVL(Q.AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD, H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD)) AS PROCESS_GROUP
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CSPD002TG WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO) AS DOC_PAGE_NUM ,NVL(Q.AI_INPT_SVR_INF_TXT, ' ') AS AI_INPT_SVR_INF_TXT ,NVL(Q.LST_DB_CHG_DTM, M.LST_DB_CHG_DTM) AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM
,NVL(Q.RPROC_TCN, 1) AS RPROC_TCN --재처리횟수 ,NVL(Q.LST_DB_CHG_DTM, H.LST_DB_CHG_DTM) AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --최종변경일시 ,(SELECT EXTRACT(SECOND FROM PROC_TIMESTAMP_T.PROC_TIMESTAMP) FROM( SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - TO_TIMESTAMP(SUBSTR(NVL(Q.LST_DB_CHG_DTM ,H.AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM), 1, 14), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS PROC_TIMESTAMP FROM DUAL) PROC_TIMESTAMP_T ) AS PROC_SEC ,(SELECT EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM PROC_TIMESTAMP_T.PROC_TIMESTAMP) FROM( SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - TO_TIMESTAMP(SUBSTR(NVL(Q.LST_DB_CHG_DTM ,H.AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM), 1, 14), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS PROC_TIMESTAMP FROM DUAL) PROC_TIMESTAMP_T ) AS PROC_MINUTE ,(SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM PROC_TIMESTAMP_T.PROC_TIMESTAMP) FROM( SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - TO_TIMESTAMP(SUBSTR(NVL(Q.LST_DB_CHG_DTM ,H.AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM), 1, 14), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS PROC_TIMESTAMP FROM DUAL) PROC_TIMESTAMP_T ) AS PROC_HOUR ,(SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM PROC_TIMESTAMP_T.PROC_TIMESTAMP) FROM( SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - TO_TIMESTAMP(SUBSTR(NVL(Q.LST_DB_CHG_DTM ,H.AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM), 1, 14), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS PROC_TIMESTAMP FROM DUAL) PROC_TIMESTAMP_T ) AS PROC_DAY /*,(SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - TO_TIMESTAMP(SUBSTR(NVL(Q.LST_DB_CHG_DTM ,H.AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM), 1, 14), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISAI_INPT_PROS_NMS') AS PROC_TIMESTAMP FROM DUAL)*/ FROM CSPD001TM M ,CSPD900TI Q ,CSPD008TH H WHERE M.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ( '20' --이미지스캔(신규) ,'21' --이미지스캔(재스캔) ,'30' --문자인식 및 항목추출 (정상) ,'40' --문자인식 및 항목추출 (재추출) ,'50' --AI 자동심사 (수기) ,'60' --AI 자동심사 (정상) ,'70' --AI 자동심사 (재심사) ) AND M.INPT_MST_SRNO = Q.INPT_MST_SRNO(+) AND M.INPT_MST_SRNO = H.INPT_MST_SRNO AND H.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO = (SELECT MAX(AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO) FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = H.INPT_MST_SRNO)
AND M.INPT_RCP_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
) X WHERE 1=1
AND X.AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD = #{aiSysInptPrgStcd}
AND X.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || #{schRefNo} || '%'
AND (X.PROC_DAY * 24 * 60) + (X.PROC_HOUR * 60) + (PROC_MINUTE) > #{aiInptProcTime}
AND X.AI_INPT_PRC_DSCD != '3'
AND X.AI_INPT_SVR_INF_TXT = #{btnFlag}
ORDER BY X.INPT_RCP_DT
ORDER BY X.INPT_RCP_DT DESC
ORDER BY X.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD
ORDER BY X.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD DESC
ORDER BY X.ACTL_FX_REFNO
ORDER BY X.ACTL_FX_REFNO DESC
ORDER BY X.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD
ORDER BY X.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD DESC
ORDER BY X.AI_INSPE_ENO
ORDER BY X.AI_INSPE_ENO DESC
ORDER BY X.AI_INPT_PRC_DSCD
ORDER BY X.AI_INPT_PRC_DSCD DESC
ORDER BY X.AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD
ORDER BY X.AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD DESC
ORDER BY X.RPROC_TCN
ORDER BY X.RPROC_TCN DESC
ORDER BY X.PROC_DAY ASC, X.PROC_HOUR ASC, X.PROC_MINUTE ASC, X.PROC_SEC ASC
ORDER BY X.PROC_DAY DESC, X.PROC_HOUR DESC, X.PROC_MINUTE DESC, X.PROC_SEC DESC
ORDER BY X.AI_INPT_SVR_INF_TXT
ORDER BY X.AI_INPT_SVR_INF_TXT DESC
ORDER BY X.DOC_PAGE_NUM
ORDER BY X.DOC_PAGE_NUM DESC
ORDER BY X.INPT_MST_SRNO
ORDER BY X.INPT_MST_SRNO DESC
ORDER BY X.LST_DB_CHG_DTM
ORDER BY X.LST_DB_CHG_DTM DESC
ORDER BY X.PROC_DAY DESC, X.PROC_HOUR DESC, X.PROC_MINUTE DESC, X.PROC_SEC DESC

/* 관리자메뉴 - 시스템심사진행현황 (8050) */ /* AdminStatusMapper.selectDailyList */ SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN PAPS_RE_SCAN_NED_YN IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS DAILY1, -- 스캔건수(합계) NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) < 80 AND PAPS_RE_SCAN_NED_YN IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DAILY2, -- AI자동심사 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) IN (80, 90) AND PAPS_RE_SCAN_NED_YN IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DAILY3, -- 심사중 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('100', '130') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DAILY4, -- 결재중 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('140', '160') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DAILY5, -- 완료 NVL(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CSPD002TG WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO)), 0) AS DAILY6 -- 총 이미지수 FROM CSPD001TM M WHERE M.INPT_RCP_DT = REPLACE(#{schSdate},'-','')

/* aside (공통) */ /* AdminStatusMapper.selectAsideList */ SELECT COUNT(A.INPT_MST_SRNO) AS SCAN_CNT --스켄건수 --AI자동심사 중 16:회전각도추출결과오류, 24:OCR추추렬과오류, 32:추출오류, 42:심사오류, 47:SW필터링오류, 심사이력 미존재시, 오류 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD < 80 THEN CASE WHEN A.Q_PRG_STCD IN ('16','24') OR A.LST_ACVT_STSCD IN ('21','32','42','47') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END ),0) AS ERR_CNT --오류건수 --AI자동심사 중 지연기준시간(분) 초과시 지연 (오류를 제외한) , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD < 80 THEN CASE WHEN A.Q_PRG_STCD IN ('16','24') OR A.LST_ACVT_STSCD IN ('21','32','42','47') THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.LEAD_MIN > B.DELAY_BAS_MIN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END ELSE 0 END ),0) AS DELAY_CNT --지연건수 --AI자동심사 중 오류와 지연을 제외한 건수 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD < 80 THEN CASE WHEN A.Q_PRG_STCD IN ('16','24') OR A.LST_ACVT_STSCD IN ('21','32','42','47') THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN A.LEAD_MIN > B.DELAY_BAS_MIN THEN 0 ELSE 1 END END ELSE 0 END ),0) AS NORMAL_CNT --정상건수 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN (80, 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INSP_CNT -- 심사중 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN (100, 130) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS APPR_CNT -- 결재중 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN (140, 160) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CMPL_CNT -- 완료 , NVL(SUM(A.IMG_CNT), 0) AS TOT_IMG_CNT -- 총 이미지수 FROM ( SELECT M.INPT_MST_SRNO , ROUND((SYSDATE - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(M.LST_DB_CHG_DTM,1,14),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) * 24 * 60 ,0) AS LEAD_MIN , TO_NUMBER(M.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) AS AI_INPT_ACVT_CD , Q.AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD AS Q_PRG_STCD , (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN ('20', '60') AND AI_INPT_PRC_OPI_TXT IS NOT NULL THEN '21' ELSE AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD END) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC ) AS INPT_TASK_ID FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS LST_ACVT_STSCD , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CSPD002TG WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO) AS IMG_CNT FROM CSPD001TM M, CSPD900TI Q WHERE M.INPT_RCP_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND M.PAPS_RE_SCAN_NED_YN IS NULL AND M.INPT_MST_SRNO = Q.INPT_MST_SRNO(+) ) A , (SELECT AI_INPT_SORT_SEQ AS DELAY_BAS_MIN FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '371' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = '01') B --지연기준시간
SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO, AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO, TRN_LOG_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO IS NULL
